name: bgs-ehp-change-request-tracker
description: Google Apps Script web app to record and monitor EHP/NHIP/INV change requests

scripts.clasp:create-test: clasp create --type standalone --title "[TEST] EHP Change Request Tracker" --rootDir dist && node -e "require('fs').renameSync('.clasp.json','.clasp.test.json')"
scripts.push:test: node scripts/build.mjs --with-integration && node scripts/check-clasp-target.mjs .clasp.test.json && clasp -P .clasp.test.json push --force
scripts.push:prod: node scripts/build.mjs && node scripts/check-clasp-target.mjs .clasp.prod.json --prod && clasp -P .clasp.prod.json push --force
scripts.clasp:create-prod: node scripts/build.mjs && clasp create --type standalone --title "EHP Change Request Tracker" --rootDir dist && node -e "require('fs').renameSync('.clasp.json','.clasp.prod.json')"
